name: Charles Sturt Pathways to Practice Placement Scholarship
summary: Weekly payment for Charles Sturt students in financial need doing compulsory work integrated learning placements.
key: Eligible students can receive $338.60 per week of placement to a maximum of $2,708.80.
who: Enrolled in a Commonwealth Supported Place
Studying an undergraduate course, or a First Nations student in an undergraduate or postgraduate course
Doing a subject with a compulsory work integrated learning placement of at least 28 hours
how: Complete the online application form and attach evidence of financial need

source.label: Charles Sturt University: Pathways to Practice - Placement Scholarship

evidence.quote: Eligible students can receive $338.60 per week of placement to a maximum of $2,708.80
Enrolled in a Commonwealth Supported Place (CSP).
